name: Unseen — 2025
seen: Inspected the opening and a direct wheel-driven horizontal transition into January. The layered title, dense text surface and change of composition were observed in the browser.
translation: The actual dataset becomes the detailed surface in direction 01. Source order and target values supply its structure; the reference’s letter field, colors and composition are not reused.

name: Studio Null
seen: Inspected the blue rendered object in the opening and the Info state. Info shifts the object into the background and prioritizes readable text.
translation: Direction 03 uses the contrast between one carefully rendered subject and a quiet surrounding interface. The object is made from original analytical surfaces.

name: GMB Graphic
seen: Inspected the large fixed identity, a central showreel and differently scaled surrounding work. Its type has compositional force rather than serving as a neutral heading.
translation: Direction 02 uses extreme type scale and a cropped excerpt of actual DataTrust evidence. It does not reuse the work, visual assets or lettering from the reference.

name: Ottografie / Exo Ape
seen: Inspected the Beauty overview and opened For Those With Character. The source study’s spatial framing, large subject type and quiet context control were observed. The creator case study supplies additional rationale.
translation: Directions 04 and 05 explore an analytical subject at a much larger scale. Data and source excerpts replace photography. Portfolio subject matter and navigation assets are not copied.
